# Test user-supplied components loaded from a directory.

md2html -components comp -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# The custom component renders through its own template, with a
# Markdown body.
grep '<aside class="note">' output/README.html
grep '<h4>Heads up</h4>' output/README.html
grep '<code>code</code>' output/README.html

# A custom definition replaces the built-in of the same name.
grep '<div class="custom-card">' output/README.html
! grep '<div class="md-card">' output/README.html

# Built-ins the directory does not mention stay available.
grep 'class="md-card-group"' output/README.html

# Attribute rules from the manifest are enforced.
stderr '<Note> is missing required attribute'
stderr '<Note> has no attribute'

rm -rf output

# A component template with no place for the body is a configuration
# error, reported before any page is written.
! md2html -components broken -html output -html-ext html testsite
stderr 'load components'
stderr 'does not reference'
! exists output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Custom components

<Note title="Heads up">
Body with `code`.
</Note>

<Note/>

<Note title="ok" colour="red"/>

<Card title="Overridden">
card body
</Card>

<CardGroup>

<Card title="Grouped">
grouped body
</Card>

</CardGroup>

-- comp/components.json --
{
  "components": {
    "Note": {
      "attrs": ["title"],
      "required": ["title"],
      "template": "note.html"
    },
    "Card": {
      "attrs": ["title"],
      "template": "card.html"
    }
  }
}

-- comp/note.html --
<aside class="note"><h4>{{.Attrs.title}}</h4>{{.Content}}</aside>

-- comp/card.html --
<div class="custom-card">{{.Content}}</div>

-- broken/components.json --
{
  "components": {
    "Note": {
      "attrs": ["title"],
      "template": "note.html"
    }
  }
}

-- broken/note.html --
<aside>this template has no body slot</aside>
